snippet.title: Train Goes Right Trailer
snippet.description:
Set in the early steam age, Train Goes Right is a top down experience that captures the spirit of building rails into new frontiers. Chop trees, build tracks, and stoke boilers as you grow from humble carts to mighty locomotives, bringing chill vibes and manual labor together into a satisfying feeling of steady progress

Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3475880/Train_Goes_Right/
